converter.command: cargo run --release --locked --manifest-path bench/parity/Cargo.toml --bin parity-manifest -- convert --profile <profile id> --hf-cache <hugging face hub cache> --out <file>

template.instruction: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
template.prefix:
<|im_start|>system
Judge whether the Document meets the requirements based on the Query and the Instruct provided. Note that the answer can only be "yes" or "no".<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user

decode_rule.a: zero LSTM state, initial predictor input blank; blank preserves predictor state and output
decode_rule.b: count every joint evaluation at a frame; a blank always advances by max(duration, 1)
decode_rule.c: force +1 only when the K-th evaluation otherwise advances by zero; no extra +1 after positive duration
decode_rule.d: K=10 is a bounded adaptation, not the upstream TDT per-frame rule
decode_rule.hf_equality: tokens and durations must equal HF generate on every fixture with finite unpatched encoder output
decode_rule.hf_exception_class: upstream NaN on padded input; compare independent loop against patched HF generate instead
decode_rule.natural_fixture_guard: fail if any fixture reaches K emissions at a single frame
decode_rule.nemo_deviation: v2.4.0 tdt greedy counts per-frame symbols but adds +1 even after a positive duration at the cap; this bounded rule matches neither upstream exactly
decode_rule.transformers_deviation: 5.16.1 generation_parakeet.py:280-299 bypasses the RNNT frame counter; max_symbols_per_step=10 sizes only the global output buffer

frame_counts.samples: mono 16 kHz sample frames after reference resampling

frontend.normalization: per feature, mean and sample standard deviation over valid frames only

confirmations.integer_tensors: retain BatchNorm num_batches_tracked scalar I64 counters losslessly in v1 packages

masking.attention: pairwise valid query AND valid key; finite -10000 mask before softmax, then zero masked probabilities
masking.before_first_subsampling_convolution: no extra mask beyond frontend zero padding
masking.between_subsampling_stages: zero invalid time positions after every Conv2d, including pointwise stages
masking.conformer_convolution: zero invalid positions after GLU, immediately before depthwise convolution
masking.nemo_behavior: finite -10000 sentinel, zero masked probabilities after softmax, zero padded frames after GLU before depthwise convolution
masking.reason: upstream all-masked padded query rows produce NaN under eager softmax; padded convolution neighbours contaminate valid frames
masking.unpadded_encoder_equality: bit-identical patched and unpatched encoder output on every fixture without padding

confirmations.synthetic_wav_metadata: libsndfile FLOAT WAV PEAK timestamp is zeroed; encoded samples and peak values are unchanged

word_rule.boundary: first emitted token, then each token piece beginning with U+2581
word_rule.end_ms: 80 * (last token frame_index + max(last token duration, 1)), clamped to audio duration
word_rule.no_speech: true exactly when no token was emitted; text empty and words empty
word_rule.start_ms: 80 * first token frame_index, clamped to audio duration
word_rule.text: tokenizer decode of all emitted token ids
word_rule.word: tokenizer decode of word token ids, leading/trailing whitespace stripped

modernbert-hadamard-768-v2.construction: Q = D kron(H12, H64) / sqrt(768): H12 Paley type I (q = 11, H = I + S), H64 Sylvester, D diagonal row signs; row r takes bit r % 256 (LSB first within each byte) of SHA-256(b"modernbert-hadamard-768" || sign_seed as u64 LE || r / 256 as u64 LE), set bit = -1; generated by bench/parity/src/hadamard.rs
